newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc ends weak vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc ends weak vs dlr.

text.p: 1445 GMT - The Swiss franc ended weaker versus the dollar as markets watched to see whether the Dow Jones industrial average would continue to steady after Wall Street stocks fell sharply on Friday.
The Dow rose initially as U.S. trade began, boosting the dollar.
"People are only looking at the Dow. When the Dow went up the dollar went up. The moves are very strongly correlated," said Michael Bernegger, currency analyst at CSFB.
